supporting_claims.claim: The bounded-memory repeated-block evaluator equals the imported reference for its stated domain.

supporting_claims.claim: The unchanged imported AArch64 decoder accepts all 151 recorded function instruction words.
supporting_claims.scope: Kernel-reduced vocabulary/class checks; not execution, reachability, memory safety or functional correctness

supporting_claims.claim: Every successful bounded evaluator result is an execution in the imported small-step semantics.
